title: 第一卷 第7章 月落情浓杀机暗藏第一卷 第8章 刀成破锋时
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: “秋月姐……”
秦猛眼睛瞪圆，莫名觉得口干舌燥。
沈秋月低着头，不敢看秦猛，声音轻颤如风中丝线：“猛子，我、我怕。”
怕什么？怕他还不清债？
怕再次失去这刚有起色的家？怕这眼前的光景只是泡影？
秦猛瞬间明白了。
她没有说出口的，是更深的不安与孤注一掷的依托。
“别怕，有我。”
秦猛吐出几个字。
女人没有迟疑，走到炕边，紧紧挨着他躺下，冰凉的手臂轻轻环住他的腰。
柔软的身躯贴上来，带着皂角的干净气息和属于她的温热体香。
秦猛呼吸一滞。
他并非原身那不解风情的浑人，刚服下大补的蛇胆热血，气血正自翻腾，此刻温香软玉在怀，一股热流直冲小腹。
他手掌抚上她光滑微凉的脊背，触手一片细腻温软。
略一用力，便将那轻颤的身子紧紧搂入怀中。
低头吻住她因紧张而微微发凉的唇瓣。
沈秋月浑身一僵，随即软化下来，嘴里发出一声似泣似叹的呜咽，被他尽数吞没。
她闭上眼，滚烫的脸颊埋进男人颈窝，手臂却将他搂得更紧。
秦猛能感觉到她身体的微颤和加速的心跳。
他翻身，将她置于身下，指尖挑开那水红肚兜的系带。
绸缎滑落，月光顷刻间洒满莹白，起伏晃人眼目。
女人羞不可抑，别过脸去，睫毛颤动如蝶翼，却顺从地，主动地，将自己更紧地贴向他，仿佛要嵌进他身体里。
衣物窸窣落地。
月光悄然移动，照亮了土炕上起伏纠缠的身影，和女人咬住手背，也抑制不住的细碎呜咽。
秦猛攻势如潮，她的手指无意识地深深掐入男人后背坚实的肌肉，留下几道弯月般的浅痕。
夜还长。
窗外月色温柔，将小院的轮廓勾勒得静谧安宁，仿佛暂时隔绝了外界的风雨与迫近的阴霾。
次日天未大亮，秦猛便醒了。
昨夜虽折腾到三更，此刻却精神饱满，毫无疲惫，体内气血充盈鼓荡，似有使不完的力气。
这是融合天赋与武技提升双重强化后的体魄。
他握了握拳，骨节轻响，估量着单臂气力，怕已不下千斤。
身旁沈秋月在薄被里动了动，发出窸窣轻响。
她侧过身，借着微光，安静低看着男人侧脸轮廓。
“醒了？”
秦猛转头，笑着问。
content_en:
"Sister Qiuyue..."
Qin Meng's eyes widened, and his mouth felt dry for no reason.
Shen Qiuyue lowered her head, not daring to look at Qin Meng. Her voice trembled like a thread in the wind: "Mengzi, I, I'm afraid."
What are you afraid of? Are you afraid that he won't be able to pay off his debt?
Are you afraid of losing your newly improved home again? Are you afraid that the situation in front of you is just a bubble?
Qin Meng understood instantly.
What she didn't say was a deeper uneasiness and desperate reliance.
"Don't be afraid, I'm here."
Qin Meng spat out a few words.
The woman did not hesitate, walked to the kang, lay down close to him, and gently wrapped her cold arms around his waist.
The soft body pressed against her, carrying the clean scent of soap and her own warm body fragrance.
Qin Meng's breath was stagnant.
He is not the muddled person who didn't understand the amorous feelings of his original self. He has just taken a large amount of snake gall blood, and his energy and blood are boiling. At this moment, he is holding the warm and fragrant nephrite in his arms, and a stream of heat rushes straight into his lower abdomen.
His palms touched her smooth and cool back, his tentacles were delicate and soft.
With a little effort, he hugged the trembling body tightly into his arms.
He lowered his head and kissed her lips that were slightly cold due to nervousness.
Shen Qiuyue stiffened for a moment, then softened, and let out a sob that sounded like weeping and sighing, which was swallowed up by him.
She closed her eyes and buried her hot cheeks into the man's neck, but her arms hugged him tighter.
Qin Meng could feel the slight trembling of her body and the accelerated heartbeat.
He turned over, placed her under him, and opened the tie of the crimson bellyband with his fingertips.
The silk satin slid down, and the moonlight instantly filled it with crystal white, and the ups and downs dazzled the eyes.
The woman was so embarrassed that she turned away, her eyelashes trembling like butterfly wings, but obediently and proactively, she pressed herself closer to him, as if she wanted to embed herself into his body.
Clothes rustled to the floor.
The moonlight moved quietly, illuminating the figure undulating and entangled on the earthen bed, and the woman biting the back of her hand, unable to suppress the tiny sobs.
Qin Meng's attack was like a tidal wave, and her fingers dug deeply into the solid muscles of the man's back unconsciously, leaving a few shallow marks like crescent moons.
The night is still long.
The gentle moonlight outside the window outlines the outline of the small courtyard in silence and tranquility, as if it is temporarily isolated from the wind, rain and approaching haze of the outside world.
Qin Meng woke up before dawn the next day.
Even though I worked hard until the third watch last night, I am full of energy and not tired at this moment. The energy and blood in my body are full and vigorous, and I seem to have endless strength.
This is a physique that has been strengthened by combining talent and martial arts.
He clenched his fists, his joints crackling slightly, and he estimated the strength of his single arm, fearing that it might not weigh more than a thousand pounds.
Next to her, Shen Qiuyue moved in the thin quilt and made a soft rustling sound.
She turned sideways and quietly looked down at the profile of the man's face in the dim light.
"Are you awake?"
Qin Meng turned his head and asked with a smile.
"Um."
